pipit.sh/pipit/internal/engine.RuntimeCl.why: A closure holds only its cells and code, so it reaches arena storage only through its cells, which the licence walk walks (visitClosure).

fields.inlineCells: cells: the first captures, walked by the licence walk
fields.upvalues: cells: aliases inlineCells or an external cell slice, walked by the licence walk

pipit.sh/pipit/internal/engine/program.C.why: A call site lives as long as its program, so it must hold no traced pointer to a guest value.

fields.MethodICSlots: engine metadata: method inline-cache entries (type words and compiled callees)
fields.nativeParams: engine metadata: the native parameter cache (types)
fields.NativeFastPath: the native fast-path entry: the native function or a method's receiver-free shape, never a method value bound to a receiver
fields.CachedClosure: a weak pointer to the last closure, validated by its function and root on every hit (cachedClosureMatches)
fields.ByteViewArguments: engine metadata: a bitmask of the arguments a reads-only native may receive as a string's own bytes

pipit.sh/pipit/internal/engine.nativeFas.why: The call site's native entry lives as long as its program, so it must not keep a method value bound to a receiver.

fields.fn: the native function value, or nil at a method site: never a method value bound to a receiver
